description: Shows the mite account, the user behind the API key and its role, plus the mode and tools this server offers. Call it first to learn what you are allowed to do; for projects use `mite_list_projects`, for customers `mite_list_customers`. Returns account name, title and currency, the user id, name and role, and the server mode with the names of all enabled tools. Takes no input and is available in every mode.
name: mite_whoami
title: Who am I in mite
